params.body:
Preparation for dropping `dealers.is_demo_user` (step 2b of removing the demo flag; #892 retired the demo garages, #901 removed every read of the flag).

About 140 test fixtures and one seeder still write `'is_demo_user' => 0` when they create a dealer. Nothing reads the value, and 0 is the column's default, so the pair says nothing. It has to go before the column can: once the column is dropped, every one of these inserts would fail on an unknown column.

This is the first half of that sweep: 71 files: `DemoScreensSeeder` and `tests/Feature` in alphabetical order up to `PrintWithoutAColourTest`. The second half follows in its own pull request, and the migration with the code removal after that. The change was split because a single snapshot of all files was too large to propose.

## What changes

Only the `'is_demo_user' => 0` pair is removed from each fixture array. No assertion, no test name and no other value changes; the diff removes 77 lines and rewrites 60 that carried the pair among other keys.

## Tests

Full suite locally on a private database with the schema of main: 2649 tests, green. PHPStan: no errors.
params.title: Fixtures no longer set the demo flag (1 of 2)
